review.posthog_relevance: Billing token payload differentiation between authenticated user requests and service-only requests.
review.reason: The observed hunks demonstrate a substantive, bounded change: adding an `email` field to billing token payloads when a user is authenticated and asserting its absence when no user is present. This distinguishes user-authenticated billing requests from service-only requests, potentially aiding downstream billing or identity-dependent workflows. The implementation and relevant checks
review.uncertainty: The actual downstream benefit or operational necessity of carrying the email field is not demonstrated; this could be a preparatory change or a minor behavior correction rather than a systemic improvement. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.
